title: What chimpanzees at war have taught me about being human
title_zh: 黑猩猩之战让我学到了什么是人类
abstract: Seeing a deadly ‘civil war’ unfold among chimpanzees has been a painful experience for John Mitani. His decades of watching wild great apes now evoke his family’s experience with xenophobia. But to him, the war highlights what makes humans unique: not our conflicts, but our unparalleled capacity for tolerance and cooperation.
abstract_zh: 目睐野生大猩猴间‘内战’的惨烈过程，让约翰·米塔尼倍感痛苦。他数十年来对野生大猿的观察，如今唤起了自己家族遭受排外经历的记忆。然而在他看来，这场战争凸显了人类独有的特质：并非我们的冲突，而是无与伦比的容忍与合作能力。
